ref_text: To create a new page, I have to create a new file like this and then I have to write front matter. So this is the process of creating a new page.

gates.note: us and match come from the studio voicecheck.py at scene level; tail, rise, WER are checked inside qwen_server.py

ref_source: assets/voice/hark_fumadocs_a.mp3 37.31-49.04 s, mono 24 kHz, no processing

pause_rule.note: sentences voiced as separate takes and joined with exact silence; a sentence under 5 words merges into its neighbour; scene = lines joined with 400 ms (same as round 7)

retry_policy: 4 attempts per take (per sentence in sentences mode); if none pass, send the request again with a new seed. Line 01 failed one 4-take group and passed the next.
loudness: level_db -19 = one gain to speech RMS -19 dBFS (ElevenLabs lines average -19.2)
selection: among takes that pass the gates, keep the highest F0 std in semitones (gates.f0_track)

server.contract: see docstring at the top of qwen_server.py
